findings.title: Not met: No purchase tags tied to Shopify thank-you / checkout URLs — GTM-PTRFZ24
findings.detail: 1 active tag(s) fire on checkout / thank-you URLs or events: Custom HTML #549. This container loads on the storefront, and with Checkout Extensibility it no longer runs on checkout or thank-you pages, so these tags most likely never fire. Why it matters: Missing purchase conversions starve bidding algorithms and understate ROAS.
findings.recommendation: Move purchase conversions to Shopify Customer Events (app pixel or a custom pixel subscribing to checkout_completed), then confirm Google Ads / Meta purchase conversions are recording.

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 ecommerce funnel coverage — GTM-PTRFZ24
findings.detail: Configured in GTM: add_to_cart, remove_from_cart, select_item, view_cart, view_item, view_item_list. Missing core: begin_checkout; missing recommended: add_shipping_info, add_payment_info. `purchase` is not in GTM — expected on Shopify (checkout runs outside GTM); confirm a Customer Events pixel or app sends it. Why it matters: Gaps or split ownership break funnel reports and double-count shared events.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing funnel events with items[] from the dataLayer.

findings.title: Needs attention: Snapchat — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Theme inline script x18; Shopify app proxy: elevar x4; Shopify native app pixel (sandboxed) x2. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one deployment route per platform.

findings.title: No consent banner shown to this (US) visitor

Meta runs through GTM / theme code, not the native Shopify app — is the Conversions API sent server-side anywhere (Elevar, Stape, a CAPI gateway)?
Which conversion action is primary for purchases — the Google & YouTube app, a GTM tag or a GA4 import — and is enhanced conversions on?
TikTok runs outside the native Shopify app — is the Events API connected for purchases?
Do you sell into the EU/UK or Quebec, and how is consent handled for those visitors?
Are browse- and cart-abandonment flows live in Klaviyo, and are Viewed Product / Added to Cart metrics recording?
